title: I Copied My Cat’s Angry Meow… He Had No Idea What to Do! 😂🐱 #Shorts
description:
My cat was biting me… so I decided to speak his language. 😂🐱

The moment I copied his angry meow, he suddenly had absolutely no idea what to do.

He was ready to fight…
until I started fighting back in cat language. 😂

That confused face says it all. 😭
